name: while-you-wait
description: Shows a rotating zikr above the prompt while Claude is working

show_azkar.title: Show azkar
show_azkar.description: while-working: only while Claude is working. always: above the prompt all the time, changing at the pace set in Seconds per zikr.

seconds_per_zikr.title: Seconds per zikr
seconds_per_zikr.description: How long each zikr stays before the next one shows.

terminal_harakat.title: Harakat in the terminal
terminal_harakat.description: hide: show the adhkar without harakat in the terminal, where they are drawn taller than a row and spill into the line above. show: keep them. The desktop app and VS Code always show them.
